howToPlay: Use your lance to deal maximum damage at long range while keeping enemies at a distance. Use your Super to gain speed and damage reduction to dominate the battlefield. Combine your gadgets and star powers to stay alive and expose enemies for increased damage.
gears: Equip Damage and Health to maximize survival and offensive pressure during close combat. Use Shield to increase your overall health pool for better durability.
trait: This brawler suits players who enjoy aggressive tank gameplay with the ability to balance ranged poking and sustained durability.
